method: Parent full-size visual comparison of each exact original and deterministic p5.brush conversion, with the same prompt, seed and renderer. This is a qualitative paired review of eight preselected native-only text scenes, not an estimate of all 600 programs.
decision: Reject deterministic helper replacement as a training-data improvement. Do not scale it to 55 candidates. Retain originals as correction states; generate complete render-inspect-revise paintings and admit only visually reviewed improvements.

rows.reason: The converted tortoise loses shell contrast and the irregular dark pen strokes compete with the animal.
The converted jet, ground crew and vehicles lose definition; wash artifacts produce jagged edges without added depth.
The converted rowboat hull becomes transparent and merges into water; the original boat silhouette reads clearly.
The frog becomes a translucent green silhouette, weakening anatomy, eye contrast and the leaf separation.
Jar, shelf and scale silhouettes are washed out while stray diagonal marks remain prominent.
The flock retains some individual marks but loses figure-ground contrast and the shepherd becomes even harder to identify.
The stacker and containers lose solid load-bearing geometry; translucent shapes make the lifting action less legible.
The fox loses its strong orange silhouette, leg definition and warm/cool separation against the snow.
